rule.description: Suspicious outbound communication to known Tor Exit Node / Command and Control (C2) server detected

full_log: Sysmon Event 3: Network connection detected: ProcessId: 4820, Image: C:\Windows\Temp\beacon_agent.exe, User: NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM, Protocol: tcp, Initiated: true, SourceIp: 192.168.1.105, SourcePort: 49821, DestinationIp: 185.220.101.5, DestinationPort: 443, DestinationHostname: malicious-c2-domain.com

analyst_input.notes: Observed active outbound beaconing to known malicious C2 IP 185.220.101.5 (Abuse confidence: 96%). Process executed from temp directory by SYSTEM account.
analyst_input.remediation: Endpoint LAPTOP-P3NHGSR9 isolated from subnet; IP 185.220.101.5 added to perimeter firewall blocklist; malicious payload beacon_agent.exe quarantined; SYSTEM user token revoked.
